plugins.description: Review royalties, rights, valuation, and deal materials for music catalog transactions.

skills.name: recoup-catalog-analysis
skills.description: Use when analyzing or valuing a music catalog for acquisition, financing, sale, or investment deal review. Triggers include "catalog valuation", "music catalog analysis", "project catalog value", "what is this catalog worth", "NPS multiple", "NLS multiple", "quality of earnings", "royalty cash flows", "catalog acquisition", "recoupment cliff", "PRO bonus", "normalize royalties", or "build an investment memo" for publishing or master rights.
skills.description_zh: 分析评估音乐版权目录的收购、融资、出售或投资交易，涵盖出版及录音版权、NPS/NLS 倍数、收益质量、版税现金流、回收期断点、PRO 奖金、版税标准化和投资备忘录。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-analyze
skills.description: Run normalized-catalog analysis (royalties, risk, concentration, valuation scenarios) — Phases 3 and 4 only. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-analyze`, says "refresh the analysis", "rerun the valuation analysis", "update the workpapers", or wants to refresh the analysis phase after editing ingest output or assumptions. For full end-to-end runs prefer /recoup-catalog-deal.
skills.description_zh: 仅执行音乐版权目录流程第 3、4 阶段的标准化分析，包括版税、风险、集中度和估值情景；用于导入结果或假设修改后的分析与工作底稿刷新，完整流程使用 recoup-catalog-deal。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-dashboard
skills.description: Use when building, refreshing, or improving the customer-facing executive dashboard (DASHBOARD.html) for a music catalog deal. Trigger on "build the dashboard", "render the dashboard", "create the executive dashboard", "refresh DASHBOARD.html", or any phase of /recoup-catalog-deal that produces the customer's read-the-deal artifact.
headings: What the dashboard SHOULD contain (when the data exists)
What you CAN add (encouraged when the deal asks for it)
Three ways a `$`-figure on the page is considered trustworthy
skills.description_zh: 创建、刷新或改善音乐版权目录交易面向客户的高管看板 DASHBOARD.html，作为客户阅读交易结论的交付材料。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-deal
skills.description: One-command end-to-end music catalog deal review. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-deal`, says "review this catalog", "analyze this music catalog deal", "value this catalog", "do diligence on this deal", "underwrite this catalog", or asks for a full catalog acquisition / seller-prep / financing review. Scaffolds the workspace, normalizes the data room, runs analysis, builds an agent-authored DASHBOARD.html, validates it, and drafts the IC memo without stopping for permission between phases. The default front door for the recoup-catalogs-plugin.
headings: Phases (run in order, do not pause)
Phase 2 — Ingest (≤2 minutes for a typical data room)
Phase 5 — Build the dashboard (the AHA moment)
skills.description_zh: 以单一入口完成音乐版权目录交易审阅：建立工作区、标准化数据室、运行分析、创建验证 DASHBOARD.html 并起草投资委员会备忘录；原说明将其作为收购、卖方准备和融资尽调的完整流程。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-demo
skills.description: Run /recoup-catalog-deal end-to-end on the bundled synthetic catalog so a first-time user can see an executive dashboard within ~60 seconds. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-demo`, says "show me the demo", "run the catalog demo", "let me see what this plugin produces", or asks for a sample / dry-run catalog deal against bundled data.
headings: 1. Scaffold the demo workspace from the bundled template + seed source.
2. Move findings template into place (the template ships under
3. Seed assumptions.yaml. Overwrite the template values with demo-specific values.
skills.description_zh: 用包内合成音乐版权目录数据完整运行 recoup-catalog-deal 演示，展示高管看板及插件产物；原说明宣称首次体验约 60 秒，用于样例或试运行。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-ingest
skills.description: Use when ingesting a music catalog data room, royalty statements, rights files, metadata exports, or messy catalog spreadsheets for a deal review. Triggers include "catalog data room", "clean royalty statements", "normalize royalties", "music rights review", "catalog ingest", "merge catalog metadata", "prepare this catalog for valuation", or seller files containing ISRCs, ISWCs, splits, PRO statements, distributor reports, contracts, recoupment schedules, or YouTube Content ID reports.
skills.description_zh: 导入并整理音乐版权目录数据室、版税报表、权利文件、元数据导出和杂乱表格，涵盖 ISRC/ISWC、分成、PRO、发行商、合同、回收安排及 YouTube Content ID 报告，为估值审阅准备标准数据。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-kickoff
skills.description: Set up a music catalog deal workspace and first deal-review request list — Phase 1 only. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-kickoff`, says "start a new catalog deal", "scaffold a workspace", "set up a data room review", or wants to set up a deal workspace without running the full end-to-end pipeline. For full end-to-end runs prefer /recoup-catalog-deal.
skills.description_zh: 仅完成音乐版权交易流程第 1 阶段，建立工作区和首批审阅资料请求清单；适用于先启动数据室审阅而不运行完整流程。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-package
skills.description: Assemble the executive HTML dashboard plus an IC memo, seller cleanup report, financing pack, or post-close administration package — Phases 5–6 only. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-package`, says "build the IC memo", "package this deal", "draft the seller cleanup report", "assemble the financing pack", or "build the post-close admin plan". For full end-to-end runs prefer /recoup-catalog-deal.
skills.description_zh: 仅执行音乐版权交易流程第 5、6 阶段，组合高管 HTML 看板与投资委员会备忘录、卖方清理报告、融资材料或交割后管理包。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-qc
skills.description: Run deal-review quality control before a catalog package is shared — Phase 6 QC only. Refreshes the executive dashboard with the latest findings. Use whenever the user types `/recoup-catalog-qc`, says "QC the deal", "run quality control on this deal", "check before sharing", "is this ready to send", or wants a pre-share QC gate after editing findings or memos. For full end-to-end runs prefer /recoup-catalog-deal.
skills.description_zh: 在音乐版权交易材料共享前执行第 6 阶段质量检查，并按最新发现刷新高管看板；适用于修改结论或备忘录后的交付前核验。

skills.name: recoup-catalog-report
skills.description: Use when the user wants to turn a deal's dashboard, memos, and workpapers into a single shareable, emailable PDF report. Trigger on "build the PDF report", "export the report", "make a PDF I can email", "share this deal", "PDF version of the dashboard", "buyer-ready PDF", "IC-ready PDF", "financing pack PDF", or any request to package a catalog deal for distribution.
headings: What the report SHOULD contain (when the data exists)
What you CAN add (encouraged when the deal asks for it)
How to convert HTML to PDF
Path A — Headless Chrome (fastest, no Python deps)
Path B — Playwright (most reliable, one-time Python install)
Path C — WeasyPrint (pure Python, print-typography excellent, no JS)
Path D — ReportLab / fpdf2 (from-scratch PDF, maximum control)
skills.description_zh: 将音乐版权交易看板、备忘录和工作底稿整合为单一 PDF 报告，便于向买方、投资委员会或融资方共享及邮件传递。

skills.name: recoup-deal-kickoff
skills.description: Use when starting a new music catalog deal, setting up a data room review, creating a deal workspace, preparing deal-review requests, or triaging a catalog acquisition, recoup-seller-prep, or financing opportunity. Triggers include "start a catalog deal", "kick off this deal", "set up the data room", "new catalog acquisition", "prepare deal request", or "create deal workspace".
skills.description_zh: 启动音乐版权目录收购、卖方准备或融资机会的审阅，建立数据室和交易工作区，准备资料请求并初步分流。

skills.name: recoup-financing-underwrite
skills.description: Use when underwriting a music catalog for an advance, loan, credit facility, securitization, collateral package, or royalty-backed financing. Triggers include "catalog financing", "underwrite this catalog", "advance rate", "collateral package", "royalty loan", "financing pack", "debt capacity", or "lender deal review".
skills.description_zh: 对音乐版权目录的预付款、贷款、授信、证券化、抵押品或版税支持融资开展承保分析，涉及预付率、偿债容量及贷款方交易审阅材料。

skills.name: recoup-ic-memo-package
skills.description: Use when creating an investment committee memo, buyer deal-review package, bid recommendation, seller cleanup report, financing pack, or final catalog deal summary. Triggers include "IC memo", "investment memo", "deal package", "bid recommendation", "catalog memo", "prepare the deal package", or "package this catalog analysis".
skills.description_zh: 创建音乐版权交易的投资委员会备忘录、买方审阅包、出价建议、卖方清理报告、融资包或最终交易摘要。

skills.name: recoup-post-close-admin
skills.description: Use after a music catalog acquisition closes, when transferring royalty administration, updating registrations, tracking ownership changes, monitoring first statements, or preventing post-close income leakage. Triggers include "post-close", "transfer administration", "registration updates", "catalog migration", "first post-close statements", "income leakage", or "ownership transfer plan".
skills.name_hint: recoup · post · 结账/关闭 · admin
skills.description_zh: 在音乐版权收购交割后转移版税管理、更新登记和所有权、监控首次报表，规划目录迁移并检查收入流失。

skills.name: recoup-rights-review
skills.description: Use when reviewing music catalog ownership, chain of title, split sheets, publishing agreements, recording agreements, assignments, sample clearances, liens, reversions, territory restrictions, or transferability. Triggers include "chain of title", "rights review", "split sheet review", "does seller own this", "sample clearance", "reversion risk", or "catalog legal docs".
skills.description_zh: 审阅音乐版权目录所有权和权属链、分成表、出版录音协议、转让、采样许可、留置权、权利回归、地域限制与可转让性。

skills.name: recoup-royalty-audit
skills.description: Use when auditing music royalty statements, checking reported revenue, normalizing royalty ledgers, finding missing income, validating NPS/NLS, reviewing PRO/MLC/DSP/distributor statements, or investigating royalty anomalies. Triggers include "royalty audit", "check these statements", "missing royalties", "statement normalization", "income leakage", "MLC mismatch", or "PRO statement issue".
skills.description_zh: 审计音乐版税报表和收入，规范台账、查找遗漏、验证 NPS/NLS，并核查 PRO、MLC、DSP 和发行商报表及异常差异。

skills.name: recoup-seller-prep
skills.description: Use when preparing a music catalog for sale, improving catalog readiness, cleaning metadata before going to market, creating a seller cleanup report, finding missing documentation, or maximizing catalog value before a buyer's deal review. Triggers include "prepare catalog for sale", "seller prep", "maximize catalog value", "catalog audit checklist", "clean up before sale", or "what should we fix before going to market".
skills.description_zh: 为音乐版权目录出售做准备，清理元数据、查找缺失文件、生成卖方整改报告，评估上市前应修复的问题及交易审阅准备程度。
